rung_note.prep: vision_tower+multi_modal_projector->bf16, embed_image fp32 cast removed; 74 layernorm modules -> bf16 (own parameters only)

experiment: T016 step 3 (A4): pi0_bf16_both+nopad vs pi0_bf16_both (pad) -- DRAM bytes per frame, E12b graph-level ncu method
throttled: not sampled during the ncu capture (ncu serialises kernels, so clocks do not bear on bytes); jetson_clocks applied immediately before (queue scratch/queues/t016_followup.sh)
command: bash bench/run_ncu_e14.sh results/20260926_E14_pi0_nopad_MAXN/bytes pad,nopad 5 (after a no-ncu warm-up: bench/e14_bytes_target.py --variants pad,nopad --frames 2)
method: ncu --graph-profiling graph --cache-control none, E12b lts__ metric set; harness graphs_both (prefix = one CUDA graph, expert = one graph), NVTX <variant>_prefix / <variant>_expert, 5 frames per stage; expert range drops the two KV-fill prefix workloads; reads = L2 fills from memory (device+sysmem) x 32 B; writes = L2 write sectors x 32 B (upper bound)

variant_tokens.bf16_both: E7's rung exactly (casts + model.denoise_step@reduce-overhead, pg.embed_image@reduce-overhead+clone, pg.forward@max-autotune-no-cudagraphs)
variant_tokens.stock: shipping sample_actions timestep: torch.tensor(<float>, device) rebuilt every step
variant_tokens.hoist: the N timestep tensors built once and reused (corun.timestep_tensors); nothing else
variant_tokens.shipping_full: the whole frame through policy.predict_action_chunk (E7's `full` loop)
variant_tokens.stages: the whole frame as corun.prefix_stage + corun.expert_stage (same compiled callables)
variant_tokens.owngraph_expert: denoise_step compiled WITHOUT cudagraph trees (same Inductor kernels) and the N-step expert loop captured as ONE torch.cuda.CUDAGraph with its OWN pool
variant_tokens.kv_copy: STALE (never in a committed E12b label): an early harness version copied each frame's KV / pad / noise into the expert graph's static buffers on the EXPERT stream. Replaced by dbuf_kv before any committed run
variant_tokens.dbuf_kv: each frame's KV cache and pad mask copied, on the PREFIX stream at the end of prefix(k) (counted in the prefix stage), into expert-owned buffer k % 2; the expert graph captured for that parity reads only that buffer; prefix(k) first waits for expert(k-2), the last reader of that buffer
variant_tokens.owngraph_prefix: graphs_both only: the whole prefix (embed_image compiled mode='default' + the VLM prefill) captured as ONE torch.cuda.CUDAGraph in the harness's own pool; required so the prefix can be confined to a green partition (M0)
variant_tokens.memo_681: graphs_both only: modeling_pi0.py:681's att_masks -> torch.tensor conversion memoised on its contents (a constant per prompt length), because a captured graph cannot contain the host sync it performs; numerics identical
variant_tokens.serial_full_gpu: M5 arm (b): the fair serial frame (prefix then expert, same harness and graphs) on the WHOLE GPU, no partition, one frame after another
variant_tokens.prio_prefix_<p>/prio_expert_<p>:
whole-GPU mechanism rows: that stage's stream created with CUDA stream priority

as GRANTED (-5 highest)
variant_tokens.maxconn_<n>: CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=<n> in the process environment (hardware work queues per context)
variant_tokens.hog_max / hog_matched / hog_<x>GBps: hog_<rate> instances. max = the hog graph (4 x 128 MiB device copies) with no sleep. matched = a torch.cuda._sleep between copies, binary-searched so the hog ALONE in the expert's partition moves the fair expert's average demand by E6 BYTES (638 046 208 B per step / measured B per step), its rate taken as bytes copied / graph time (CUDA events), NOT EMC. <x>GBps (M4 calibration) = that same bytes/time rate for one sleep setting
variant_tokens.prefix_first: per frame the host issues prefix(k) before expert(k-1)
variant_tokens.expert_first: per frame the host issues expert(k-1) before prefix(k)

prefix in a green-context partition of

SMs, expert in a disjoint one of ; each stage's graph CAPTURED inside its own green context (M0: a graph captured on the primary context is NOT confined when replayed on a green stream)
